meta.title: Primordial Reconstruction – 1
meta.description: What sort of world will you create once you make up your mind to stop hesitating?

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, inside the Gabon Research Lab's Data Center.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, inside the Gabon Research Lab's Data Center.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, inside the Gabon Research Lab's Data Center.

units.rawText: Hubble and Fresnel run frantically through the various file rooms until they come to a stop in front of one particular door.
units.displayText: Hubble and Fresnel run frantically through the various file rooms until they come to a stop in front of one particular door.

spans.text: Hubble and Fresnel run frantically through the various file rooms until they come to a stop in front of one particular door.

units.rawText: ...Found it. These are the hard drives Xuannu left in the data center.
units.displayText: ...Found it. These are the hard drives Xuannu left in the data center.

spans.text: ...Found it. These are the hard drives Xuannu left in the data center.

units.rawText: This is the essence of the entire Jiutian sector... It's essential for rebuilding the sector after the reset. We need to get them on the spaceship.
units.displayText: This is the essence of the entire Jiutian sector... It's essential for rebuilding the sector after the reset. We need to get them on the spaceship.

spans.text: This is the essence of the entire Jiutian sector... It's essential for rebuilding the sector after the reset. We need to get them on the spaceship.

units.rawText: Warning— Signs of entropization detected inside the base. Device malfunctions detected in communications room and Lab No. 12.
units.displayText: Warning— Signs of entropization detected inside the base. Device malfunctions detected in communications room and Lab No. 12.

spans.text: Warning— Signs of entropization detected inside the base. Device malfunctions detected in communications room and Lab No. 12.

units.rawText: It's coming faster than we expected.
units.displayText: It's coming faster than we expected.

spans.text: It's coming faster than we expected.

units.rawText: We're out of time, Fresnel. Give me your terminal; I'll sync the sector reset progress to it so we can know the its condition at all times.
units.displayText: We're out of time, Fresnel. Give me your terminal; I'll sync the sector reset progress to it so we can know the its condition at all times.

spans.text: We're out of time, Fresnel. Give me your terminal; I'll sync the sector reset progress to it so we can know the its condition at all times.

units.rawText: Alright, I'll start moving the hard drives. Let's meet at the spaceship.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll start moving the hard drives. Let's meet at the spaceship.

spans.text: Alright, I'll start moving the hard drives. Let's meet at the spaceship.

units.rawText: Okay, I'm counting on you!
units.displayText: Okay, I'm counting on you!

spans.text: Okay, I'm counting on you!

units.rawText: The hard drives containing an entire sector's worth of research data and observation logs are not light or portable by any stretch of the word. Even with the spaceship's own loading mechanisms helping out, moving them is a tiring task for Fresnel.
units.displayText: The hard drives containing an entire sector's worth of research data and observation logs are not light or portable by any stretch of the word. Even with the spaceship's own loading mechanisms helping out, moving them is a tiring task for Fresnel.

spans.text: The hard drives containing an entire sector's worth of research data and observation logs are not light or portable by any stretch of the word. Even with the spaceship's own loading mechanisms helping out, moving them is a tiring task for Fresnel.

units.rawText: Fresnel eyes the boxes before her warily; in order to protect against zero gravity and vibrations, all the large devices on the spaceship were welded in place. Is there really a way to get the hard drives beyond the reach of the Heat Death?
units.displayText: Fresnel eyes the boxes before her warily; in order to protect against zero gravity and vibrations, all the large devices on the spaceship were welded in place. Is there really a way to get the hard drives beyond the reach of the Heat Death?

spans.text: Fresnel eyes the boxes before her warily; in order to protect against zero gravity and vibrations, all the large devices on the spaceship were welded in place. Is there really a way to get the hard drives beyond the reach of the Heat Death?

units.rawText: Warning— Labs No. 1, 4, 5 and 7 have been entropized. Device malfunctions detected...
units.displayText: Warning— Labs No. 1, 4, 5 and 7 have been entropized. Device malfunctions detected...

spans.text: Warning— Labs No. 1, 4, 5 and 7 have been entropized. Device malfunctions detected...

units.rawText: Isn't Lab No. 4 right next to us...
units.displayText: Isn't Lab No. 4 right next to us...

spans.text: Isn't Lab No. 4 right next to us...

units.rawText: <size=40>Fresnel!</size>
units.displayText: Fresnel!

spans.text: Fresnel!

units.rawText: Hubble rushes out of the control center and boards the ship.
units.displayText: Hubble rushes out of the control center and boards the ship.

spans.text: Hubble rushes out of the control center and boards the ship.

units.rawText: How are the hard drives?
units.displayText: How are the hard drives?

spans.text: How are the hard drives?

units.rawText: Yup, all stowed and secured.
units.displayText: Yup, all stowed and secured.

spans.text: Yup, all stowed and secured.

units.rawText: But how are we going to take away such huge objects?
units.displayText: But how are we going to take away such huge objects?

spans.text: But how are we going to take away such huge objects?

units.rawText: The terminal displays the total amount of mass within the Jiutian sector. The sector can only be reset once the amount of entropized mass reaches the designated amount.
units.displayText: The terminal displays the total amount of mass within the Jiutian sector. The sector can only be reset once the amount of entropized mass reaches the designated amount.

spans.text: The terminal displays the total amount of mass within the Jiutian sector. The sector can only be reset once the amount of entropized mass reaches the designated amount.

units.rawText: However, some things don't count toward this amount. These things can be taken beyond the Heat Death's reach.
units.displayText: However, some things don't count toward this amount. These things can be taken beyond the Heat Death's reach.

spans.text: However, some things don't count toward this amount. These things can be taken beyond the Heat Death's reach.

units.rawText: ...Like say, people like us from outside the sector!
units.displayText: ...Like say, people like us from outside the sector!

spans.text: ...Like say, people like us from outside the sector!

units.rawText: Correct. That implies you can use non-sector mass as a substitute for sector mass, which can then be taken out of the sector.
units.displayText: Correct. That implies you can use non-sector mass as a substitute for sector mass, which can then be taken out of the sector.

spans.text: Correct. That implies you can use non-sector mass as a substitute for sector mass, which can then be taken out of the sector.

units.rawText: So we can entropize stuff on the ship to substitute for the hard drives!
units.displayText: So we can entropize stuff on the ship to substitute for the hard drives!

spans.text: So we can entropize stuff on the ship to substitute for the hard drives!

units.rawText: Hubble, you're a genius!
units.displayText: Hubble, you're a genius!

spans.text: Hubble, you're a genius!

units.rawText: Well, it's just a hypothesis... I hope it works out. In any case, let's go test it out.
units.displayText: Well, it's just a hypothesis... I hope it works out. In any case, let's go test it out.

spans.text: Well, it's just a hypothesis... I hope it works out. In any case, let's go test it out.

units.rawText: Got it. I'll dismantle a part of the ship and dump it in the entropized area of the base.
units.displayText: Got it. I'll dismantle a part of the ship and dump it in the entropized area of the base.

spans.text: Got it. I'll dismantle a part of the ship and dump it in the entropized area of the base.

units.rawText: Hubble and Fresnel dispatch one of the ship's drones with a small amount of equipment and send it into the entropized regions. As the escape pod disintegrates, the progress bar additionally fills a little on top of its existing rate.
units.displayText: Hubble and Fresnel dispatch one of the ship's drones with a small amount of equipment and send it into the entropized regions. As the escape pod disintegrates, the progress bar additionally fills a little on top of its existing rate.

spans.text: Hubble and Fresnel dispatch one of the ship's drones with a small amount of equipment and send it into the entropized regions. As the escape pod disintegrates, the progress bar additionally fills a little on top of its existing rate.

units.rawText: This is great! Your hypothesis worked out! This way, we can save all the hard drives!
units.displayText: This is great! Your hypothesis worked out! This way, we can save all the hard drives!

spans.text: This is great! Your hypothesis worked out! This way, we can save all the hard drives!

units.rawText: The ship needs to take off before the Entropy draws near. We'll dump all the substitute mass from the spaceship once we're airborne.
units.displayText: The ship needs to take off before the Entropy draws near. We'll dump all the substitute mass from the spaceship once we're airborne.

spans.text: The ship needs to take off before the Entropy draws near. We'll dump all the substitute mass from the spaceship once we're airborne.

units.rawText: But if the entire Earth gets entropized, where will we leave from? The ship's almost out of power.
units.displayText: But if the entire Earth gets entropized, where will we leave from? The ship's almost out of power.

spans.text: But if the entire Earth gets entropized, where will we leave from? The ship's almost out of power.

units.rawText: Fly north, toward the North Pole. Anna opened a backdoor to the sector there.
units.displayText: Fly north, toward the North Pole. Anna opened a backdoor to the sector there.

spans.text: Fly north, toward the North Pole. Anna opened a backdoor to the sector there.

units.rawText: Okay, got it!
units.displayText: Okay, got it!

spans.text: Okay, got it!

units.rawText: Warning— High-energy entropization reaction detected in the vicinity of the vessel...
units.displayText: Warning— High-energy entropization reaction detected in the vicinity of the vessel...

spans.text: Warning— High-energy entropization reaction detected in the vicinity of the vessel...

units.rawText: Here it comes!
units.displayText: Here it comes!

spans.text: Here it comes!

units.rawText: A menacing horde of entropics closes in on the spaceship. They are like a towering tsunami, ready to swamp an isolated, vulnerable little rowboat before it.
units.displayText: A menacing horde of entropics closes in on the spaceship. They are like a towering tsunami, ready to swamp an isolated, vulnerable little rowboat before it.

spans.text: A menacing horde of entropics closes in on the spaceship. They are like a towering tsunami, ready to swamp an isolated, vulnerable little rowboat before it.

units.rawText: Fresnel grits her teeth and fires up the engines. With the aid of the thrusters, the spaceship soon escapes the entropized region.
units.displayText: Fresnel grits her teeth and fires up the engines. With the aid of the thrusters, the spaceship soon escapes the entropized region.

spans.text: Fresnel grits her teeth and fires up the engines. With the aid of the thrusters, the spaceship soon escapes the entropized region.

units.rawText: The end... is upon us.
units.displayText: The end... is upon us.

spans.text: The end... is upon us.

units.rawText: Hubble looks longingly at the now-purple sky, as though bidding it a final farewell.
units.displayText: Hubble looks longingly at the now-purple sky, as though bidding it a final farewell.

spans.text: Hubble looks longingly at the now-purple sky, as though bidding it a final farewell.

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: Hubble opens the hatch door, and the hot winds heated by the red giant Sun wash into the cabin as alarms go off.
units.displayText: Hubble opens the hatch door, and the hot winds heated by the red giant Sun wash into the cabin as alarms go off.

spans.text: Hubble opens the hatch door, and the hot winds heated by the red giant Sun wash into the cabin as alarms go off.

units.rawText: Hold hatch is not closed. Cabin pressure abnormality detected.
units.displayText: Hold hatch is not closed. Cabin pressure abnormality detected.

spans.text: Hold hatch is not closed. Cabin pressure abnormality detected.

units.rawText: Fresnel, keep the ship steady. I'll dump the things that can substitute the hard drives' mass out the rear.
units.displayText: Fresnel, keep the ship steady. I'll dump the things that can substitute the hard drives' mass out the rear.

spans.text: Fresnel, keep the ship steady. I'll dump the things that can substitute the hard drives' mass out the rear.
